name: YDK-gen (YANG Development Kit)
description: Software development tool providing API generation from YANG models with services for NETCONF, RESTCONF, OpenDaylight, and gNMI. Supports Python, Go, and C++ code generation from YANG model bundles.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker image automatically built with latest ydk-gen commit. Supports Ubuntu Xenial through Noble. Docker image is the easiest way to run ydk-gen without native installation.

eval_notes: Most comprehensive multi-language YANG API generator. Bundle profiles allow customizing scope per use case. Docker image is the recommended approach for running the generator. Generates SDKs for Python/Go/C++ with protocol-specific services.
